name: genpark-personal-knowledge-vault-graph-compiler-skill
description: Personal knowledge vault graph compiler and bi-directional link indexer parsing [[wikilinks]], tags, and unlinked mentions across personal notes (inspired by Obsidian and Roam).
author: AlphaPark

tools.name: index_note
tools.description: Index personal markdown note and extract outgoing wikilinks and tags.

tools.name: query_backlinks
tools.description: Query incoming backlinks and neighbor connections for a note.

tools.name: compute_vault_analytics
tools.description: Compute graph centrality, density, and isolated orphan notes.

tools.name: run_vault_benchmark
tools.description: Run knowledge vault graph compiler benchmark.
